question: In Hila Qu’s explanation of PLG conversion paths, what tradeoff should a company consider between letting customers buy online and involving sales for high-usage, ideal-customer accounts?
expected_points: Online self-service can be automated, low-cost, and efficient for products customers can buy within their budget.
High-usage accounts that fit the ideal customer profile may warrant sales or customer-success outreach and white-glove service, potentially leading to a larger deal.
evidence_quote: this customer worth more of your time and you should actually not, even if they may want to buy on their own, you may want to still have your sales team or have your customer success team to reach out to them
